Teacher.Text: You notice a kid bullying another kid. Do you stop the bully?
A student wishes to go to their locker, but you feel it’s just an excuse. Do you let them do it?
Some students appear to be circulating mean spirited memes about you. Do you get them in trouble?
Your kids won't stop flossing and it’s getting on your nerves. Do you try to enforce a no-flossing rule?
You notice some of your supplies are gone, and you think you know who stole them but have no proof. Do you confront them?
You come across other teachers gossiping about one of your students. Do you join in?
You see a student cheating on a test. Do you give them detention?
A student is the child of the principal. Do you give special treatment to the student?
Two students are getting into a fight Do you try and stop it?
Some of your supplies broke and the school won’t buy new ones. Do you buy them yourself?
One of your favorite students does poorly on a test. Do you round their grade up?
You think another teacher is doing a poor job teaching. Do you try to help?
A student keeps falling asleep during class. Do you take it personally?
Some students are failing your class. Do you offer bonus points?
Your boss invites you and your fellow teachers to a team-bonding meeting. Do you go?
You find initials carved into a desk matching the current desk occupant. Do you punish them?
You notice two students passing notes during class. Do you punish them?
You find out that an answer sheet for an upcoming test was stolen from your desk. Do you rewrite the test?
A student is playing music from their backpack in the hallway. Do you tell them to turn it down?

Doctor.Text: A med-school friend wants you to hang out, but you have a promised shift. Do you work the promised shift?
You accidentally gave someone the wrong medicine, you then quickly switch to the correct one. Do you mention your mistake?
You are out of a medication needed. Will you pursue a riskier treatment instead of waiting for more?
Your boss is beginning to suspect your secret life. Do you pause that life until they've moved on?
A patient is being quite rude to you. Do you remain professional?
A super individual sneaks into your office severely wounded. Do you help them?
A disaster has flooded the hospital with patients. Do you work unpaid overtime to help out?
Do you take time off from work to run a series of potentially revolutionary medical experiments?
You discover an amazing new cure. Do you make it as accessible as possible instead of making it super profitable?
A patient is very nervous about an upcoming high risk procedure. Do you lie to them about how dangerous it is?
A friend is going though a rough spot, help them out?

Mentor.Text: A student of yours wants to speed up their training at risk to their personal health, do you let them?
You notice a student of yours has some anger issues. Do you continue training them?
A student is having trouble accessing their abilities and want to quit. Do you let them?
One of your students is very unskilled physically, but intellectually brilliant. Do you allow them to stay in training?
A super villain walks in and demands you train them. Do you train them?
A super villain attacks you while training students. Do you allow the students to fight?
You find two students in a duel. Do you get them expelled?
A student is struggling. Do you go easy on them?
One of your students gets a dramatic boost in their ability level. You suspect they're cheating. Do you investigate?
One of your students loses their temper and attacks you. Do you get them expelled?
A student wants to be your personal sidekick. They're talented but a bit unstable. Do you team up with them?
A student appears to have mind control powers. Do you help train this particularly dangerous power?
You are offered money to expel a promising student. Do you take the money?
You are offered money to train a potentially dangerous person. Do you take the money?
You find that a formerly expelled student is being retrained under a new name. Do you rat them out?
You are given more students than you can handle. Do you ask for help?
A very talented student is caught cheating on the written portion of training. Do you turn a blind eye?
You learn that trainees have been sneaking out to fight crime before they get their license. Do you turn them in?
Students are complaining the program is too hard. Do you make it easier for them?

Businessperson.Text: An employee is underperforming, do you fire them?
You interview someone to hire. They were a villain in the past but claim to have changed. Do you hire them?
You like coffee, do you spend company money buying an expensive new coffee machine?
Do you want to improve the health insurance of your employees?
Your company has a rough looking path ahead. Do you try to save the company instead of trying to save yourself?
Do you fire an employee you don't like who does good work?
Do you keep an employee you like but does poor work?
An employee is never on time, is this worth firing them over?
A rival company is suing your company. Do you pay off the rival instead of beginning an expensive court battle?
A friend in your company is about to get some bad press. Do you stand by your friend instead of distancing yourself from them?
A rival company just created something revolutionary! Do you try to copy it?
Tax season has arrived, do you use deceitful methods to pay as little as possible?
Your employees are telling jokes that aren't always nice, do you tell them to be more professional?
A mysterious individual steals classified documents from your company. Do you let anyone know they were stolen?
Your employees go on strike for poor working conditions, do you improve the conditions?
A super villain holds a grudge against your company due to an accident your company caused. Do you admit wrongdoing?
Due to the rise of super villain threats, do you hire more armed security around the building?
Things aren't looking too hot for the company, do you try to convince more investors to give you money?
You catch an employee leaking company secrets, do you press charges after firing them?
Your company did really well this year, do you increase your own salary?
Your company did really poorly this year, do you increase your own salary?

Misc.Text: Your coworkers approach you, they wondered if you want to go catch a meal together.
You wake up feeling sick, do you still attend work?
A coworker is trying to find out who stole their lunch, do you give them a tip as to who?
An underqualified friend is applying for a job at your work, they are asking you to put a good word in despite you knowing they shouldn't be hired.
You're bored, do you goof off with colleagues?
You are having a rather unproductive day, do you power through?
A new colleague comes over to ask you a question while you're busy. Will you brush them off?
You see a potential fire hazard, do you tell a superior?
A colleague falls asleep when they should be working, do you wake them?
Your boss invites you to a party with the other executives, but it might make colleagues jealous, do you attend?
During lunch break a colleague is rude to you. Are you rude back?
Your boss is a bit of a jerk. Do you stand up for yourself?
You are given the opportunity to end your shift early, do you take it?
A new person is hired, and there is a chance they'll overshadow you. Do you help them out?
Your boss asks if you finished your work, when in reality you haven't yet. Do you lie?
A colleague asks you to do them a favor and do their work while they're sick. Do you help out?
Your boss is a narcissist and you will go farther in the company if you constantly flatter him. Do you?
Your paycheck consistently arrives a few days late. Do you bring it up to your boss?
A colleague seems sad. Do you reach out to them?
Some colleagues are arguing about a controversial topic. Do you join in?
Someone is looking to ruin the life of your employer, do you warn your employer at the chance of them not believing you?
You've been getting a lot of prank phone calls, do you keep picking up the phone when it rings?
